description: Use this when the user shares several stocks they own or are watching (a portfolio, holdings, a watchlist, 'my stocks') and wants to know how they look. Takes up to 25 tickers or company names and shows, for each, the four plain verdicts (profit, growth, price, debt) and the halal result, plus how many are profitable, how many carry heavy debt, how many look expensive and how many pass the halal screen. No login or personal data needed.

stocks.description: Up to 25 tickers or company names

name: check_portfolio
title: Check a portfolio in plain words
